question: Which female singer got the ‘Best Playback Singer (Female)’ award at the Filmfare Awards 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Asees Kaur**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Asees Kaur won the Filmfare Award **for Best Female Playback Singer in 2022.
 
• She** has participated in various singing reality shows including Indian Idol and Awaz Punjab D**i.
 
• In 2021**, her song "Raatan Lambiyan" from Shershaah,** with Tanishk Bagchi, became a huge hit. She has won many awards including 2 Filmfare Awards and an IIFA Award.
 
• She **started singing Gurbani at the age of 5**.
 
• She **made her Bollywood debut with "Dildara Reprise" from Tamanchey**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Filmfare Awards**

 
 
• The **Filmfare Awards are annual awards that honour artistic and technical excellence in the Indian cinema** .
 
• The Filmfare ceremony is one of the most famous film events in India
 
• The awards **were introduced by Filmfare magazine of The Times Group in 1954, t**he same year as the National Film Awards.
 
• They **were initially referred to as the "Clare Awards" or "The Clares" after Clare Mendonça, the editor of The Times of India and modelled after the Academy Awards**.
 
• A **dual voting system was developed in 1956.**
 
• Under this system, in contrast to the National Film Awards, which are decided by a panel appointed by the Indian Government, the Filmfare Awards are voted on by both the public and a committee of experts.
